chavi_client.dashboard module¶

This file was generated with the customdashboard management command and contains the class for the main dashboard.

To activate your index dashboard add the following to your settings.py::

GRAPPELLI_INDEX_DASHBOARD = ‘chavi_client.dashboard.CustomIndexDashboard’

class chavi_client.dashboard.CustomIndexDashboard(**kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Dashboard

Custom index dashboard for www.

init_with_context(context)[source]¶

Sometimes you may need to access context or request variables to build your dashboard, this is what the init_with_context() method is for. This method is called just before the display with a django.template.RequestContext as unique argument, so you can access to all context variables and to the django.http.HttpRequest.
